parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'alerts') AS alerts, (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'n8n_status') AS status

INSERT INTO app_settings (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('n8n_status', $1::jsonb, now()) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = app_settings.value || EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now() RETURNING key
